subject.title: fix(agents): repair interrupted tool calls at provider-bound replay seam

question: Should the canonical fix repair messages only at the provider-bound replay seam, or mutate every session-loading consumer before provider policy is known?
rationale: The two open candidates choose different ownership boundaries with different compatibility blast radii; repository policy favors the narrow provider-aware seam, but a maintainer should confirm the canonical path before either branch is repaired or landed.

options.title: Use provider-bound repair
options.body: Rebase this PR, retain the transcript-policy gate, cover every current provider-bound rebuild assignment, and require persisted-session provider proof.

options.title: Use session-loader repair
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106935 only if all buildSessionContext consumers should intentionally receive synthetic results, with compatibility proof for those consumers.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Keep both branches open only until a maintainer selects the repair owner and closes the non-canonical implementation path.

recommendation.title: Use provider-bound repair
recommendation.body: Rebase this PR, retain the transcript-policy gate, cover every current provider-bound rebuild assignment, and require persisted-session provider proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the adjacent repair and replay behavior and is best positioned to confirm its intended ownership boundary.
